verdict.rationale: incident.io documents Workflows that trigger automated actions on incident events (e.g. auto-publishing status page updates, follow-up creation, webhooks for event-driven automation), which supports condition-based automation of toil like updates and field changes. However, the evidence pack lacks a dedicated 'Workflows' engine page detailing conditions/triggers/actions configuration in depth — only auto-publishing and adjacent features are directly cited. Missing for 10: a first-party doc explicitly describing the workflow engine's condition-based trigger/action model (e.g. 'when X happens, do Y' rules beyond status-page publishing), evidence of reminders/field-change automation specifically, and independent/hands-on confirmation of workflow reliability.
